article.title: The U.S. government is escalating its attack on Palestine activism in Michigan
article.author: Yarden Azoulay Katz
article.content: Four more pro-Palestine activists have been indicted on "conspiracy" charges stemming from protests at the University of Michigan, bringing the total to 12. The defendants now face sentences ranging from five years to several decades.
